how: We read the website of every Los Angeles wedding planner listed on Lazo (148 listings, 110 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: a destination-wedding travel company, an Orange County studio, a Santa Barbara planner, venues that also sell coordination, and a national photo-and-DJ chain. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: Which permits and insurance does my venue need, and do you handle the city paperwork for a private estate or beach ceremony?
Full planning, partial or month-of? Ask what each tier includes in hours, meetings and vendor management.
Who is on site on the wedding day, the planner I hired or an associate, and how many weddings do you take per weekend?

picks.name: David Pressman Events
picks.blurb: David Pressman describes his studio as one of the nation's premier producers of bespoke weddings, each built from hand-picked elements for one couple. His approach draws on a background in high fashion, fine art, film and philanthropy, and the Los Angeles studio handles planning, design and destination weddings.

picks.name: Master Plans Events & Designs
picks.blurb: Founded in Los Angeles by Yingka Chou, who has over 20 years producing events, Master Plans is a boutique full-service planning and design company. Full-service wedding planning covers Greater Los Angeles, Orange County, Santa Barbara, Hawaii and Northern California.

picks.name: Ayanda Whiting Events
picks.blurb: Ayanda Whiting Events plans and designs weddings around your story, with a stated focus on honoring heritage, cultural background and family traditions. Couples mention her templates, resources and checklists, and the Claremont studio serves Southern California and Utah.

picks.name: Say I Do to Details
picks.blurb: Say I Do to Details runs a team of lead planners and promises the same attention and quality whichever one you are paired with. Luxury weddings and social events out of Redondo Beach, with services sized from small jobs to full planning and design.

picks.name: Love Is Sweet Events
picks.blurb: Candace Lam started Love Is Sweet Events in 2012 after helping friends with their weddings and says she still gets emotional watching couples walk down the aisle. Luxury wedding and corporate planning in Southern California, with flexible wedding planning packages listed on the site.

picks.name: Beyond the Event
picks.blurb: Juliana Holmes spent nearly a decade teaching kindergarten before her own wedding turned her toward design and logistics. Beyond the Event in Long Beach offers full-service planning and design, month-of coordination and floral artistry, and travels wherever the story goes.

picks.name: Manifestive Events
picks.blurb: Cortney came to events from the New York stage and more than a decade in production, catering, florals and design, with a stretch singing in a wedding band. Manifestive Events plans around genuine moments of connection rather than aesthetics alone.

picks.name: So Smitten Special Events
picks.blurb: Marni Farmer of So Smitten Special Events is a wedding and event planner, coordinator and design consultant in Los Angeles. Beyond planning and coordination, the company offers event service staffing that can be booked on its own.

picks.name: Tricia Dahlgren Events
picks.blurb: Tricia Maldonado has helped couples plan since 2009 and is known, in her words, for a calm approach, clear communication and strong attention to detail. TD Events offers packages from full-service planning to day-of coordination across Southern California.

picks.name: To Be Loved Events
picks.blurb: Samantha leads To Be Loved Events with a stated commitment to celebrating all love stories and an eye for immersive event design and a good rom-com. Thoughtful weddings across Los Angeles and Ventura County, with customizable packages and pricing published on the site.

picks.name: Rock n' Willow Events
picks.blurb: An alternative planning and coordination company for offbeat, unique and themed weddings, established in Long Beach in 2013 by a married couple who have been together since high school. Rock n' Willow offers a complimentary consultation and tailors base packages, with prices on the site.

picks.name: Anything But Gray Events
picks.blurb: Holly Gray is an event planner, creative director and speaker producing bold, colorful and inclusive weddings across California and beyond. Anything But Gray Events has been featured by BuzzFeed and Equally Wed and leans on strategy and design to break the mold.
